newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - TRO Learning still buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - TRO Learning still buy.

text.p: -- Barrington Research Associates Inc Tuesday maintained its buy rating for TRO Learning Inc in spite of fourth-quarter earnings that fell sharply below analysts' estimates of $1.05.

-- The company last month announced earnings of $0.34 per share in the fourth quarter, compared to $0.71 per share one year ago. TRO Learning said it was unable to recognize a significant portion of new orders as revenue because they did not meet all of the accounting requirements.
-- Barrington Research said TRO Learning stock still remains attractive for the longer term.
--TRO Learning shares were unchanged Tuesday afternoon at 11-1/8.
